name: enable_mergejoin
description: Controls whether the query planner considers merge join as a possible execution strategy for joining tables.
symptoms: Higher CPU usage due to less efficient join methods
Excessive disk I/O from nested loop or hash joins on large sorted datasets
tuning_tips: Disable only if merge joins consistently produce worse performance than alternatives for your workload; monitor EXPLAIN output to compare plan costs before and after. Typically left enabled unless specific join patterns benefit from forcing other methods.
